description: Isolation and resource invariants of the HyperOS host, checked at runtime by vmm-daemon (docs/REVIEW_FIXES.md, Part R).

variables.name: nat_spaces_running
variables.description: Running or paused Spaces in nat mode

variables.name: nat_spaces_lan_blocked
variables.description: Of those, Spaces whose nftables table still drops guest traffic to non-global IPv4, all guest IPv6, and unsolicited traffic to the host

variables.name: reserved_ram_mib
variables.description: Sum of maximum RAM of running and paused Spaces (MiB)

variables.name: largest_capture_bytes
variables.description: Size of the largest packet capture written by this daemon (bytes)

requirements.fretish: host shall always satisfy nat_spaces_lan_blocked = nat_spaces_running
requirements.rationale: A nat Space reaches the public internet only. If its firewall table is flushed or altered, the guest could reach the LAN or the host.

requirements.fretish: host shall always satisfy reserved_ram_mib <= ram_budget_mib
requirements.rationale: Running and paused Spaces must never be promised more RAM than the host can spare; swap is not admission capacity.
A capture stops at 256 MiB so a guest cannot fill the data partition.
